caption:
This penguin sentence has one bad word.

Swap in "they are." If the sentence still works, the answer is they're.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Their, there, they're: the swap test.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Their vs There vs They're
youtube.description: Spot the error: their used where the sentence needs they're. SAT-style practice question (original).
